description: List every paid Frontera Signal endpoint before you spend anything. Covers Rio Grande Valley, Texas market data: construction (permits, building-input prices, housing supply, commercial projects filed with the state, company track records, filed cost per square foot, material shelf prices, the weekly briefing), bridge wait times, border crossings, peso, diesel, city sales tax, new businesses, bar and restaurant alcohol sales and home health agencies. Each entry has the price per call in USDC, what the call returns, an example question, its parameters with valid values and a free sample URL. Free.
name: list_endpoints
title: List paid endpoints
